simple.meaning: אַרְוָדִי (ʼArvâdîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “an Arvadite or citizen of Arvad.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אַרְוָדִי (H721) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 10:18, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַרְוָדִי (H721) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אַרְוָדִי (H721) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אַרְוָדִי (ʼArvâdîy) / H721 is traced through Genesis 10:18, 1 Chronicles 1:16 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
